info.name: Paid Signal (PayPal sandbox demo)
info.description: Read-only requests against the live Paid Signal demo, each with tests. Write actions (refunds, invoice drafts and sends) are left out on purpose: use the dashboard for those.

item.name: Ledger: PayPal payments recorded per ad

request.description: Captures recorded from PayPal's capture response and signature-verified webhooks. Payer emails are stored only as SHA-256 hashes.

exec: pm.test('every payment carries an ad and a capture id', () => d.payments.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.capture_id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('ad'); }));
pm.test('money is a two-decimal string', () => d.payments.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.amount).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{2}$/)));

request.description: Ad export (ad, spend, leads) joined with PayPal captures by the click id packed into each order's custom_id. Amounts in cents.

exec: pm.test('paid orders never exceed leads per ad', () => r.ads.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.paid).to.be.at.most(a.leads)));
pm.test('Meta and Google payloads are prepared', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.meta.events).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.google.conversions).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: PayPal invoices drafted by the Studio agent. Drafts are never sent without a person pressing Send.
Compares the ledger with PayPal's own history: matched, after the report's last refresh, missing, or in PayPal but not in the ledger.

exec: pm.test('reports ok or unavailable, never a guess', () => pm.expect(['ok','unavailable']).to.include(d.status));
if (d.status === 'ok') pm.test('says how current the PayPal report is', () => pm.expect(d).to.have.property('report_current_to'));

request.description: Approve and Dismiss on agent recommendations, logged on the server with their evidence.

exec: pm.test('each decision keeps its evidence', () => pm.response.json().decisions.forEach(d => pm.expect(d.evidence).to.be.an('array')));
